profiles.name: Advanced kidney decline
profiles.summary: Kidney function is already well below normal on the blood test.
profiles.patient: Your blood test shows your kidneys are filtering much less than they should. A urine test tells your care team how much damage there is and which treatments will help most.
profiles.clinic: Confirm CKD on the problem list, order ACR, review nephrology referral and medication doses.

profiles.name: Blood-sugar driven
profiles.summary: Diabetes with high HbA1c is the main reason for the risk.
profiles.patient: High blood sugar over time can damage the small filters in the kidneys. A urine test can find this early, while better sugar control and kidney-protecting medicines work best.
profiles.clinic: Order ACR with the next HbA1c. A positive result supports SGLT2 inhibitor and ACE inhibitor or ARB discussions.

profiles.name: Ageing kidneys
profiles.summary: Older adults whose eGFR has drifted below 60, often with heart disease.
profiles.patient: Kidney function naturally declines with age, and yours is lower than average. A urine test shows whether there is also early damage that treatment can slow.
profiles.clinic: Order ACR alongside the annual review. Check BP targets and medicines cleared by the kidney.

profiles.name: Blood-pressure driven
profiles.summary: Systolic blood pressure well above target is the main reason.
profiles.patient: High blood pressure strains the kidneys' blood vessels. A urine test shows whether that strain has started to cause damage, and helps your doctor choose blood pressure medicines that also protect the kidneys.
profiles.clinic: Order ACR and review BP control. If albuminuria is confirmed, prefer an ACE inhibitor or ARB.

profiles.name: Borderline blood pressure
profiles.summary: Mildly raised blood pressure with otherwise reassuring results.
profiles.patient: Your risk is a little above average, mostly from blood pressure. A routine yearly urine test is enough unless your doctor advises otherwise.
profiles.clinic: Routine yearly ACR. Reinforce BP and lifestyle targets.

profiles.name: Well-controlled
profiles.summary: Blood pressure and blood sugar are near target.
profiles.patient: Your blood pressure and blood sugar are well controlled, which protects your kidneys. Keep up the yearly urine test that guidelines recommend.
